authorization: User 14-Nov: review drive gap then evaluate 10k/15k/20k with baseline under the same conditions before further long training
reset_seed_scope: Gym/reset metadata; not an exact Gazebo state or an independent training seed
primary: Fresh-QC-valid whole-robot traversal / physical goal / path / quiet-stop success by arm and layout; retain invalid and missing slots as unknown
failure_rule: Never replace a failed slot. Retain measurement-invalid slots and continue the prespecified independent slots; closure, ownership, source identity or disk failures stop the batch.
uncertainty: Pilot with two independent fresh epochs per arm/layout; no exact-state pairing or population superiority claim. Reserved validation/test layouts are not consumed.
